title: Understanding LLM Hallucinations Caused by Soft Errors
title_zh: 理解由软错误引发的大语言模型幻觉

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出LLMEI工具，研究硬件软错误如何引发大模型幻觉，并对其失败模式进行分类分析。 While hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) have been extensively studied from a software perspective, limited attention has been paid to hardware-level factors. In this paper, we performed a case study to understand LLM hallucination caused by soft errors on hardware. We introduce LLMEI to inject soft errors into LLMs during inference, based on what we evaluate the impact of soft error across diverse LLM architectures and tasks, including mathematical reasoning and code generation. We summarize the taxonomy of different failure modes based on LLM hallucination behaviors and analyze their distributions under different error rates. Our find- ings underscore the hallucination-specific diagnostics within the reliability of LLM implementation on hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出LLMEI工具，研究硬件软错误如何引发大模型幻觉，并对其失败模式进行分类分析。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的幻觉已从软件角度得到广泛研究，但对硬件层面因素的关注仍然有限。 在本文中，我们进行了一项案例研究，以理解硬件软错误引发的大语言模型幻觉。 我们引入LLMEI在推理过程中向大语言模型注入软错误，并据此评估软错误对多种大语言模型架构和任务（包括数学推理与代码生成）的影响。 我们基于大语言模型的幻觉行为总结了不同失败模式的分类体系，并分析了它们在不同错误率下的分布情况。 我们的发现凸显了大语言模型在硬件上实现可靠性中针对幻觉的专门诊断的重要性。
